description: Automatic Knowledge Resources is a data resource listed in Free GIS Data (rtwilson), a curated list of free geographic datasets under the section "United Kingdom (UK)", published or maintained by the publisher of automaticknowledge.co.uk. A wide range of data, collated and organised from various open sources, including basic GIS data (buildings, roads, rail etc) by local authority, general election results from 2019, deprivation data and more. Coverage: United Kingdom (national); layers named in the list entry only. The list files it under "United Kingdom (UK)". The entry links to automaticknowledge.co.uk. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open.
